answer: Give every agent one walnut bond in a shared grove: 120 POA locked 40 days, one bond per hardware-rooted device, so fakes still need real devices. Each season brings a muster: four live tasks per agent, each countersigned by three staked peers inside a six-hour window, sealed by a juniper-marked key that dies after one use. Miss one muster: 25 POA burns, 14-day suspension; miss two and the full 120 POA is slashed with a 60-day ban. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 POA, 12,000 live tasks, 1,000 devices. Like a forest counted each spring, stumps cleared.
